summary.text: One of the twenty-three suitors from Same on Cephallenia in Apollodorus' catalogue — a namesake of Eteoneus son of Boethous, the busy squire of Menelaus at Sparta.

story.text: Apollodorus counts Eteoneus among the wooers who came from Same, named after Thriasus and before Clytius in the island list of Penelope's suitors.
Homer's Odyssey knows another Eteoneus — the herald who met Telemachus and Peisistratus at Menelaus' gate and kindled the fire at his master's bidding — not this Same suitor.
